There are two distinct songs titled "The Happiest Girl" (or a close variant), each by a different artist. "The Happiest Girl in the Whole U.S.A." was written, composed, and recorded by Donna Fargo [d3], becoming a No. 1 country hit in 1972 and earning her a Grammy for Best Country Vocal Performance, Female [d3]; it has since become her signature song [d3]. Multiple sources confirm Donna Fargo as the original performer [d1][d2][d7][d9]. Additionally, Tammy Wynette also recorded a version of the same song, released in 1972 on Columbia Nashville Legacy [d10]. Separately, "The Happiest Girl" (without "in the Whole U.S.A.") is a song recorded by South Korean girl group Blackpink, released as the sixth track on their 2022 album Born Pink [d5][d8].
